page.043: "Every woman must feel seen, understood and accompanied. This is where true change begins."
page.044: Lucia Cotugno — Master in Charge, Luxosa Messina
page.048: I changed four salons in five years. None of them remembered what colour I had the time before, let alone my history. At Luxosa my professional knows every centimetre of my hair. She knows my colour tends to oxidise at the ends, she knows I have mixed hair — more porous in some areas. I never have to explain things again from scratch. That continuity means more to me than any technique or social media moment.
page.051: I manage a team of thirty people. I have no time to waste and no patience for improvisation. The first time I came to Luxosa, they gave me an analysis that lasted twenty-five minutes. No one had ever sat me down for that long before touching my hair. That day I understood the difference between a hairdresser and a serious establishment. Two sessions later, my hair is unrecognisable. But above all I am different when I look at myself in the mirror in the morning.
page.054: I arrived at Lucia's with destroyed hair. Home lightening, supermarket dyes, a straightening treatment that had burned my ends. I was embarrassed. The first thing they told me was: do not worry, we can do good work. No reproach, no look, no judgement. Just a clear plan to rebuild what I had damaged. After just one month the hair is healthier, and we are not even halfway through the pathway.
page.057: I have curly hair. A lifetime of feeling I should straighten it, tame it, keep it tied back. Then a friend recommended this place, and for the first time someone said: your curls are beautiful, but they are working against your scalp. Let's build a pathway that enhances them without stressing anything. No one had ever spoken to me about my hair that way. I chose the Esperienza Ricciosa — nothing like anything else I'd had. I understood that my curls matter.
page.060: I understood the difference between a regular salon and Luxosa when they told me: the colour you want requires three sessions over two months. Anywhere else they would have done it in one go, in a single session, burning everything just to please me. Here they had the courage to say no, not today. And that no gave me more confidence than a thousand yeses.
page.063: As a doctor I know that results come with consistency, not with a single intervention. The Luxosa method works exactly like this: it does not promise a miracle in one session. It offers a serious pathway, with stages, check-ins, adjustments. Over a year my hair has been transformed. Not because of any single thing they did. Because of the sum of everything done well, over time.
page.066: I am someone who wants evidence and likes data. It is not enough for someone to tell me things are improving. When Luxosa showed me images of my scalp before and after four sessions, I saw the difference with my own eyes. Not opinions. Facts. For someone used to balance sheets, this approach was decisive. I know exactly where I am and where I am going.
page.069: I started the BenEssere pathway with confidence. An investment in myself. Lucia is wonderful — I was guided throughout, as was the whole team. No pressure. All I know is that I feel well, I look better and that makes me at ease. I feel safe trusting, after so many years, in true professionals.
